title: Mark Rober's $60 Million Science Experiment

summary_zh: 前 NASA 工程师 Mark Rober 呈现了一场壮观科学实验——用零下 320°F 的液氮展示物理原理。他将火星探测器设计经验融入地面实验，以轻松易懂的方式激发观众对科学的热爱。
summary_en: Former NASA engineer Mark Rober presents a spectacular science experiment with liquid nitrogen at −320°F, demonstrating physics principles with the same ingenuity he used designing Mars rover hardware. An electrifying blend of science and showmanship.
